# TrainLens 0.18.1 — Robust training history and clearer plots

This patch fixes a history-sketch edge case and improves the visual diagnosis of
long model-training runs without changing the portable history format.

## Bug fixes

- Fix large-offset metric trajectories whose real local changes could previously
  be hidden by a tolerance derived from the absolute metric baseline.
- Use explicit observation labels when training-step metadata is incomplete;
  forced step mode preserves unknown positions as missing instead of fabricating
  step coordinates.

## Better notebook visuals

- Bound long plotted histories with deterministic min/max buckets, keeping isolated
  spikes/troughs and original endpoints; stored metric series are not modified.
- Avoid thousands of distracting point markers on dense training curves.
- Mark the best validation observation; show the final held-out test result with a
  distinctive symbol so it is not confused with a training trajectory.
- New optional `plot_training_curves(..., x_axis="auto", max_plot_points=1200,
  show_best=True)` controls; Matplotlib remains an optional install.

## Documentation and tests

- Extend the Colab quickstart with a reproducible 1,000-step demonstration and a
  bounded, provider-free notebook-context preview.
- Update the README, Python API guide, and English/Spanish notebook documentation.
- Regression tests cover large-offset histories, missing steps, long-run rendering,
  validation-vs-test behavior and notebook source compilation.

Upgrade with `pip install --upgrade trainlens==0.18.1`.
